blocks.text: 20vin sadi ke shuru mein Darwinism ko jadeed genetics ke saath mila kar Neo-Darwinism banaya gaya. Neo-Darwinism ke mutabiq evolution ki zyada durust tareef yeh hai: “population mein alleles ki frequency (har allele kitna aam hai) mein tabdeeli, ya population ki poori genetic banawat (gene pool) mein tabdeeli”. Neo-Darwinism Hardy-Weinberg Theorem par qaim hai.
